import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for input and output tiles
    sbuf_in = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # DMA copy input to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_in, src=x)
    
    # Transpose 2D within each tile
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):
        for i in nl.affine_range(128):
            for j in nl.affine_range(128):
                if i < P and j < F:
                    out[p, j] = sbuf_in[i, j]
    
    # DMA copy output from SBUF to shared HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_out)
    return out

def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for input and output tiles
    input_tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    output_tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Compute number of tiles needed
    num_tiles = (P + 127) // 128
    
    # Loop over partitions
    for p in nl.affine_range(num_tiles):
        # Compute the start and end indices for the current partition
        p_start = p * 128
        p_end = min((p + 1) * 128, P)
        
        # Copy input data to SBUF
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=input_tile, src=x[p_start:p_end, :])
        
        # Reshape and transpose
        for i in nl.affine_range(128):
            for j in nl.affine_range(128):
                output_tile[i, j] = input_tile[j, i]
        
        # Copy output back to shared HBM
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[p_start:p_end, :], src=output_tile)
    
    return out

        transposed = tile[0:F2, 0:F1].reshape(F2, F1)
        
        # Copy the transposed data back to HBM
        out[p:p+128, 0:F] = transposed.flatten()
    
    return out

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_basic_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape[1:], dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF for lhsT and rhs
    sbuf_lhsT = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape, dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_rhs = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    # Copy lhsT and rhs from HBM to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_lhsT, src=lhsT)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_rhs, src=rhs)
    # Allocate PSUM for result
    psum = nl.ndarray(shape=out.shape, dtype=out.dtype, buffer=nl.psum)
    # Perform matrix multiplication
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf_lhsT, moving=sbuf_rhs)
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_lhsT, src=psum)
    # Copy result from SBUF to HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_lhsT)
    return out
